training_scope: 14 TSA 23 IDF training plots plus 19 high-biomass IDF plots from BC TSAs 2, 5, 9, 18, 22, and 29; exact FAIB plot support and first-return LidarBC metrics.
source: FAIB Forest Inventory Ground Plots (public PSP, OGL-BC) and LidarBC point clouds (OGL-BC); FEMIC regional open-data fit 2026-10-31.

applicability.notes: Experimental regional candidate. Independent BC IDF check: 54 in-range plots, BA RMSE 8.02 m2/ha. Four-plot TSA 23 high-biomass external check was BA RMSE 6.67. TSA 23 independent subset: 7 plots, BA RMSE 15.02. Not an operational inventory.

caveats: Experimental regional candidate; not a published operational card.
Four-plot high-biomass external check is not the full validation set.
Independent BC IDF check has 54 in-range plots, BA RMSE 8.02 m2/ha; TSA 23 independent subset is 15.02 m2/ha.
Wide BC IDF plots frequently fall outside the predictor range; do not extrapolate.
